attribution.text: Generated using Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service information [Year]

provenance.notes: Atmosphere Data Store, same software as the CDS (omnilab/cds's CdsSource on ads.atmosphere.copernicus.eu). Read 2026-11-10: how-to-api and Terms of Use state no request rate, no concurrency, no User-Agent rule; each dataset's licence applies, accepted once per dataset before its first request. CAMS datasets: Licence to use Copernicus Products (rev. 12): free, worldwide, perpetual, any lawful purpose, reproduction and distribution allowed; credit (sec. 5.1) 'Generated using Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service information [Year]' or 'Contains modified ...' when modified, plus a statement that neither the European Commission nor ECMWF is responsible for any use made. Some ADS datasets carry another licence (e.g. CICERO CMIP6 indicators, non-commercial): check the dataset's. Catalogue reads need no key; submit/job need an ADS account's personal access token. No rate-limit headers seen on a test call.
